findings.body: If the canonical story record and the checkout's copy are deleted while the task and story document remain, this condition permits work without approval. Both hash checks are then skipped, allowing a changed brief to reach a full-access worker after a status commit. Missing approval must refuse unconditionally, as `src/forge/task.py:137–139` already does. Remove the test-fixture exception and cover deletion of both records.
findings.title: Not done: 8. Refuse work when both story approval records are absent

findings.body: Recovery returns immediately when the log is empty or its last entry describes a completed turn. However, `src/forge/codex_turn.py:139` starts the next turn before Forge appends its started line at `src/forge/codex.py:280`. A crash between those operations leaves a recorded conversation with an unlogged turn. The next call stops the processes but skips reading that conversation, so it neither reconciles the missing end nor refuses if Codex still reports the turn as running. Reconcile this pending-start case before allowing another turn, and test a crash before the started line is appended.
findings.title: Not done: 9. Recover turns started before their log line was written

findings.body: The supplied Functional check exercises only the approval refusal from item 8. It does not exercise continued fix rounds from item 7 or crash recovery from item 9, both covered by this part. The statement that the suite passes does not supply the required user-facing walkthrough. Exercise those paths through `forge work` and record what happened in a Functional check paragraph.
